name: tophat-watch
summary: Alerts you when a Top Hat question opens

shot.alt: Mock Top Hat classroom page with an unanswered question and the extension's Watch: ON indicator

hook: Chrome extension that sends a desktop and phone alert the moment a Top Hat question or attendance check opens.

pages.caption: The content script reports on every DOM change and every 5 s. The service worker remembers what has already alerted, so an item alerts once each time it opens.

blurb: Chrome extension that alerts when a Top Hat question opens
